 Ebrima Tunkara called up to Barcelona training ahead of El Clasico after Dani Olmo injury
 The youngster is with the senior squad.
 by Gill Clark Oct 23, 2026, 12:03 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 BARCELONA, SPAIN - AUGUST 29: Ebrima Tunkara of FC Barcelona poses during the official UEFA Champions League 2026/27 portrait session on August 29, 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. (Photo by Alex Caparros - UEFA/UEFA via Getty Images) UEFA via Getty Images Gill Clark Gill Clark is the site manager of Barca Blaugranes and joined in 2017. She has worked in sports media as a writer and editor for the best part of two decades and has been in love with the beautiful game for as long as she can remember. Barcelona boss Hansi Flick called up exciting youngster Ebrima Tunkara to first team training on Friday after losing Dani Olmo to injury for a month.
 Tunkara and Orian Goren were both summoned by the Barcelona boss as the team continued preparations for Sunday’s Clasico against Real Madrid at Camp Nou in La Liga.
 Young defender Alex Campos is also with the first team due to Barcelona’s continued injury problems in defence.
 Eric Garcia and Andreas Christensen remain sidelined, while Jules Kounde is still not back in training due to a sprained ankle and is also expected to miss the match.
 Tunkara missed the start of the season due to injury but has been back in action for Barca Atletic since returning to fitness. 
 The teenager is a player who has long been tipped to break into the first team and will be hoping he can impress Flick and earn opportunities this season.
